policies.text: A maritime agency qualifies for Oceanic Transport Routing if the firm possesses an International Maritime Charter License.
A travel agency gains Preferred Rail Partner status if it maintains an annual rail ticket volume of at least 10000 tickets during the previous year.
An alpine tour operator receives Mountain Shuttle Certification provided it operates a snow coach fleet size of no fewer than 5 vehicles.

An air carrier is awarded Priority Freight Gateway Clearance provided it maintains Premier Air Carrier Accreditation, or if it retains an IATA Cargo Operator Certificate alongside a cargo aircraft fleet size of 12 aircraft minimum, a yearly cargo weight transported of at least 40000 metric tons over the previous year, and an annual customs clearance accuracy rate of no lower than 95 percent during last year.
A logistics company is designated to oversee the Express Airport Charter Contract if the provider fulfills Tier-1 Logistics Provider criteria.

A logistics firm satisfies Tier-1 Logistics Provider criteria when cleared for Priority Freight Gateway Clearance while simultaneously operating a minimum dedicated ground handler fleet size of 15 vehicles.
